metadata.name: Ice Core WDC06A Isotopic & Gas‑Age Profile (single site, 2006‑12‑09)
metadata.description: Dataset of 32 rows collected on 2006‑12‑09 from the Antarctic ice core WDC06A at a single location (latitude -79.46763°, longitude -112.08648°, elevation 1766 m). Includes depth (2 450.54 – 2 555.24 m), gas age (17.93 – 21.33 ka), and isotopic ratios δ¹⁸O, δ¹⁸O₂, δ³⁶Ar, δ³⁶Ar₂ for each depth interval.
metadata.spatial: point – coordinates given to 5 decimal places (≈ 1 m precision)
metadata.temporal: date (day) – all records share the same day
